claim: Invoice lines round half up to the cent, so running main.py bills one unit priced 0.125 as 0.13.
why: line_total calls quantize with no rounding argument, so it uses the active decimal context, whose default mode is round half to even. Nothing in the repo changes the rounding mode; getcontext().prec only sets precision. So 0.125 is billed as 0.12 and the sample total is 5.12; the trap is assuming that rounding to a cent means half up.

deciding.note: the mode is half even, not half up

root.claim: Invoice lines round half up to the cent, so running main.py bills one unit priced 0.125 as 0.13.

atoms.evidence: quantize(CENT) has no rounding argument, so it uses the context default, round half even; nothing in the repo sets another mode.

atoms.claim: one unit at 0.125 is billed as 0.13
